$comment: Debrett's M&A advisory — scheduled and event-driven flows. Cron is UTC, five fields. Every flow produces a draft for review; none sends. See automation-map.md for the prose version.

defaults.output: out/ in the mandate or origination folder, dated
defaults.on_failure: notify the owner, do not retry silently

flows.name: Monday pipeline review pack
flows.output: Four tables plus the marginal-hour recommendation

flows.name: Weekly vendor process update, per live mandate

trigger.note: Friday morning, one run per live mandate

flows.output: One-page update for partner review, plus an internal reconciliation annex
flows.gate: Halts and reports if a log disagrees with the correspondence

flows.name: Q&A log reconciliation, exceptions only

runs.steering: Reconcile the Q&A log for <mandate>; report exceptions only

flows.output: Overdue, outstanding, and answered-but-inconsistent counts, with the items

flows.name: Monthly origination sweep, per active sector

runs.steering: Sweep <sector>: screen, score, shortlist, dossiers for priority A

flows.output: Scored shortlist A/B/C, dossiers for the A names, outreach drafts held for approval
flows.gate: Exclusion list checked before the shortlist is produced

flows.name: Signal watch on priority B and C names

runs.steering: Signal watch: report changes on the B and C list for <sector>

flows.output: Change note only where something changed: filings, directors, funding, acquisitions
flows.note: Silence is a valid output. Do not generate a note when nothing moved

flows.name: Process document set regenerated on a timetable change

trigger.event: timetable updated in the mandate project

runs.steering: Timetable changed for <mandate>: regenerate the process document set and list what must be reissued

flows.output: Regenerated set, plus a change log naming who holds a superseded version

flows.name: Verification pass before any external send

trigger.event: a document is marked ready to send

flows.output: Verification log, open items with the action that clears each, one line on readiness
flows.note: Advisory to the author, who remains responsible. It does not clear a document for sending
flows.owner: the person whose name is on the work

flows.name: Debrief after a management, buyer or pitch meeting

trigger.event: meeting notes or transcript added to the mandate project

flows.output: Actions with named owners and dates, decisions, what we learned, follow-up drafts

flows.name: Post-completion debrief and method capture
flows.output: Internal debrief, plus the list of what should become a firm skill or a sector note
